fit.method: logistic regression, no penalty, all measured-level closed-mouth days WY2019-WY2026

inputs.rain_in: Rain on the day (in), COP gauge (NOAA GHCN USW00053152, USCRN, then KSBA scaled to local CoCoRaHS), calendar day midnight to midnight, local standard time
inputs.stage: Slough level for the day (ft NAVD88): yesterday's measured daily mean (logger or live sensor) rolled forward one day with today's rain by the water balance (unified.stage_from_measured)
inputs.crest: Estimated berm crest (ft NAVD88): c_inf - (c_inf - c0) * exp(-dc / tau), c_inf 10.015, c0 6.171, tau 64.19 days; floored at the highest level in the first 3 days after the closure (known from day 4)
inputs.dc: Berm age at the start of the day: days since the mouth closed (1 on the first closed day)
inputs.maxlvl: Highest measured daily mean level since the current closure began, through the day before (ft NAVD88); the closure includes its breach day, as the site sees that morning with the mouth still closed; on the first closed day it equals stage
inputs.berm_clock: Berm age and maxlvl reset when the mouth opens (a breach or an open spell) and start again at the next closure. Days labeled leaky in data/mouth_corrections.csv (king tides over a closed berm, e.g. 2024-02-21..24) keep both running (same berm) but are not scored.
inputs.rain_wy: Rain since October 1 of the water year through the day (in), same gauge as rain_in
inputs.log_dc: Natural log of dc, the berm age in days
